meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Naver: hides ad boards and app nudges, blurs or hides news thumbnails, can hide subscribe buttons, home cards and issue tags
meta.notes:
**Checked 2026-11-13**, logged out, headless Chrome: m.naver.com and news.naver.com with an iPhone UA, www.naver.com and news.naver.com with a desktop UA. Naver is many sites under one match (home, news, cafe, blog, map, shopping); only home and News were inspected.

- **Ad boards**: on desktop home `#ad_premium_area`, `#timeboard-ex`, `#whale-banner`, `#whale-banner-bottom` matched 1 each; on News `#glad_ad_sidebox` and `#glad_ad_sidebox_secondary` 1 each; on mobile home `#HOME_AD` 1, `[data-issue-banner="ad"]` 1, `#main_search_specialda_1` 1 (LIVE). The slots were empty in the headless visit, so what they hold on a normal visit was not seen.
- **App nudges**: `#MM_HOME_NUDGE_BANNER` and `#__MM_OS_SUBSCRIBE_POPUP` exist on mobile home but are hidden until the page triggers them (LIVE for existence, INFERRED that they appear for visitors).
- **Thumbnails**: `.cnf_news_thumb`, `.cni_thumb_box`, `.cnf_journal_thumb` 242 on desktop News home (LIVE).
- **Subscribe buttons** 108 and **issue tags** 112 on desktop News home (LIVE).
- **Home cards**: the mobile home cards (`#MM_HOME_SEARCH_WEATHER`, `#MM_search_stock`, `#MM_search_disaster`) and `#MM_home_menu_container` each matched 1 (LIVE). Some cards are display:none until data arrives.

Not verified: the desktop www.naver.com home content was an empty React shell in headless Chrome (its widgets did not render), so no desktop home card rules were written. Cafe, blog and shopping were not visited. Ids and class names are stable and readable; labels are Korean but no rule uses text.
